objective: Screen one-variable fixes for causal windowing, omitted source parameters, nonworse-gate alignment, and underweighted temporal frequency bands without modifying the active B2-v4 run.

causal_window.reason: The static half-cycle rule closely reproduces the old 5%-of-future-max onset while removing its future-derived statistic.

source_cond.only_change: append normalized constant source_f0_hz and source_t0_s maps

pilot_plan.fit_and_calibration: train-only, family-balanced, stratified over f0/source_x/source_z/vmin, record and medium-group disjoint
pilot_plan.promotion: screening only; the winning conceptual variable requires a new two-seed full fit/calibration confirmation

data_gate.current_issue: The existing train manifests collectively consume all 140 Marmousi medium groups across probes, fit, calibration, and sealed confirmation.
data_gate.launch_veto: Do not reuse the opened V4 calibration panel and do not open the V4 confirmation panel for V5 tuning.
data_gate.if_v4_fails: Under a new preregistration, the still-sealed V4 confirmation groups may be explicitly retired from V4 and reassigned to V5 development.
data_gate.if_v4_passes: Use the frozen V4 confirmation exactly once, then obtain fresh generated train Marmousi groups or run a clearly labeled within-medium source-holdout pilot that cannot count as group-disjoint confirmation.

rollback: All V5 files are additive; removing them restores the pre-change workspace without touching active or protected checkpoints.
